program.objective: Demonstrate the supervisor running two dependent tasks through the real Codex runtime with no user prompt between them.

tasks.title: Create the marker file
tasks.instruction:
Create a file named exactly alpha.txt in the current working directory whose entire content is the single line: CODEX-STEP-A-DONE
Do not create or modify any other file. Stop when it exists.

tasks.title: Derive the second file from the first
tasks.instruction:
Read alpha.txt in the current working directory. Create a file named exactly beta.txt whose entire content is the single line: DERIVED-FROM:<trimmed contents of alpha.txt>
For example if alpha.txt contains CODEX-STEP-A-DONE then beta.txt must contain DERIVED-FROM:CODEX-STEP-A-DONE
Do not create or modify any other file. Stop when it exists.

acceptance.description: beta.txt records that it was derived from codex-step-a's output
